$comment: Per-platform listing setup guides (steps we execute as part of the Pro package).

airbnb.label: Airbnb
airbnb.signup: Create/use an Airbnb hosting account at airbnb.com/hosting (free to list).
steps: Start a new listing → 'Place to stay'.
Enter property type, rooms/beds/bathrooms, and capacity.
Add title + description from the drafted listing-copy.md.
Upload photos (cover photo first — we advise the recommended set).
Set house rules, check-in/out times, and cancellation policy.
Set base nightly price + weekend/special pricing in the calendar.
Set availability window and minimum-stay rules.
Connect calendar: Settings → Availability → Calendar sync → iCal URL (or channel manager if using one).
Submit for review — Airbnb typically approves within 24–72h.
Verify the listing is live by opening the public URL.

vrbo.label: Vrbo
vrbo.signup: Sign up at vrbo.com (part of the Expedia group) — hosts.list your property.
steps: Create a property listing → 'List Your Property'.
Enter property type, bedrooms, bathrooms, max guests.
Add title + description from listing-copy.md.
Upload photos (Vrbo recommends 10+ incl. exterior).
Set house rules + rental agreement language.
Set nightly/weekly rates + minimum stay in the calendar.
Connect calendar: Calendar tab → iCal import/export (or channel manager).
Enable 'Instant Book' or 'Inquiry' as preferred.
Submit for review and confirm the public listing URL.

booking.com.label: Booking.com
steps: Create property profile → choose 'Hotel / Other property'.
Enter address, property type, rooms, facilities.
Add description + policies from listing-copy.md.
Upload photos (recommended: cover + room + amenity shots).
Set room rates, availability calendar, and cancellation policy.
Connect calendar: Extranet → Rates & availability → iCal export (or channel manager).
Complete 'Bookability' checks (facilities, policies, photos).
Submit for activation; booking.com reviews within ~2 weeks.
Confirm the property is visible by searching it on booking.com.

expedia.label: Expedia
expedia.signup: List via Expedia Partner Solutions (expediaconnect.com / partnercentral).
steps: Register your property in Partner Central.
Enter property + room details and facilities.
Add photos and description.
Set rates and availability.
Connect calendar: Partner Central → Connectivity → iCal / direct (or channel manager).
Activate and verify the public property page.

hotels.com.label: Hotels.com
hotels.com.signup: Hotels.com shares Expedia's inventory — list once via Expedia Partner Central, availability flows through.
steps: Confirm the property is active in Expedia Partner Central.
Verify it appears on hotels.com by searching for it.
Ensure photos/rates are synced (same content as Expedia).
Optionally run a hotels.com-specific promo via the partner dashboard.

channel_managers.cloudbeds: Connect new channels inside Cloudbeds → Channels → add Airbnb/Vrbo/Booking.com. Rates + calendar sync automatically.
channel_managers.lodgify: Lodgify → Channels → connect OTA channels, or use the 'direct website booking widget' for own-site bookings.
channel_managers.freetobook: FreeToBook → 'Channels' tab → connect OTAs; iCal export for others.
channel_managers.siteminder: SiteMinder → Channels → add each platform as a channel; it syncs rates/availability.

ical.import: Add the property's main iCal URL to each platform's calendar-sync settings so all calendars stay in one place.
ical.export: If the owner manages manually, export one master iCal and import it into each new platform to prevent double-bookings.
